bayts.text: Whoever has thought me other than the servant of the Chosen (Muḥammad), well, I serve him with what (Allah) has chosen.
I serve him until my entry into Paradise, the Abode of permanence, of wishes and of favour.
Whoever has thought that he could ever please him with what appeared like my service,
error and leading astray have deceived him; to me there yields, from him and through him, the lawful.
I praised him already before at Libreville, with a praise the like of which every saint fell short of.
I praised him with a praise at Mayumba, which effaced my faults and stayed sin.
I praised him among the people of Kalwā, with a praise that spared me enemies and trial.
From me to him (goes) a service that has remained constant; may his Garden (his tomb at Medina) be magnified until the Resurrection.
His descendant al-Jīlānī has been pleased with me: upon him the good pleasure of the One Who raised me.
His descendant Abū l-Ḥasan (ash-Shādhilī) has been pleased with me: upon him a good pleasure that makes the beautiful everlasting.
His descendant at-Tijānī has been pleased with me: upon him the good pleasure of the One Who destroys the guilty.
The four Caliphs have been pleased with me; I have won the good pleasure of the Brought-Near, in succession.
Whoever is not pleased with me — well, the Generous has been pleased with me with a good pleasure that does not fade.
May God reward the Chosen with the best reward, just as (He) accepted and fulfilled the promise.
The blessing of Him Whose generosity comes to meet me (be) upon him who received me without dispute.
